name: BNO pool stale NFT reward accounting

classification.summary: The pool's emergency withdrawal cleared ERC-20 stake and reward-debt accounting but left the NFT reward addition active, so a later NFT withdrawal could pay rewards that were no longer backed by stake.

loss.notes: Exact pre-recovery victim depletion is the BNO balance change of pool 0xdca503449899d5649d32175a255a8835a03e4006 across the two successful campaign transactions: 1,563,370.168598147731548146 BNO immediately before the anchor and zero after the second transaction. The second receipt records 504,557.855800853399893084 USDT paid to campaign funds-holder 0xdc109426972ae14d5b3d7e91b47d42ff1fd3c8cc after the depleted BNO was sold; that exact stablecoin realization at par is used instead of the legacy rounded USD 505,000 headline or a thin-market spot mark. The attacker's flash liquidity and amounts returned to the pool are not counted separately. No recovery is netted.

lastCodeChange.description: Direct contract deployment. Its 13,327-byte runtime hashes to 0x541c5518ef3d2925449174422b64c0b7f93b043f76a507606b6dc845292666be both at deployment block 28522657 and immediately before the campaign; the EIP-1967 implementation slot is zero, and the runtime contains neither DELEGATECALL nor SELFDESTRUCT.

sources.note: The selected anchor is the earliest of the two successful BNO pool-depletion transactions reported for this campaign. Transaction 0x33fed54d...0096b9 succeeded at block 30056630 index 68 and timestamp 1689641737; the same EOA's next nonce produced transaction 0x16d75e42...76cc31 at block 30056662 index 120 and timestamp 1689641833. The receipts and archive balanceOf calls establish a coherent loss boundary: pool 0xdca503449899d5649d32175a255a8835a03e4006 held 1563370.168598147731548146 BNO at block 30056629 and zero at the end of block 30056662. The second receipt then records exactly 504557.855800853399893084 USDT sent to campaign funds-holder 0xdc109426972ae14d5b3d7e91b47d42ff1fd3c8cc, which supplies the conservative realized valuation. Receipt calls and the pinned research source identify 0xdca503449899d5649d32175a255a8835a03e4006 as the pool whose inconsistent ERC-20/NFT reward state caused the loss. Archive eth_getCode binary search places its first code at block 28522657; creation receipt 0x7a0d87d...ed9f2, index 114, names creator 0x5afdb6c84786103cca788a39e47b9b2dcea78ad9. The 13,327-byte direct runtime has hash 0x541c5518ef3d2925449174422b64c0b7f93b043f76a507606b6dc845292666be at deployment and immediately before the anchor. A zero EIP-1967 implementation slot and no DELEGATECALL or SELFDESTRUCT in that runtime support deployment as its latest executable-code change. Deployment timestamp 1685027552 makes the code 4614185 seconds old at the earliest transaction.

limitations: The USD value conservatively uses exact campaign-realized USDT proceeds at par rather than an external pre-exploit BNO mark.
